## About
Cactus Car Care is a family owned shop in Livermore, right next to Oil Changers on Portola Ave. Our goal is simple: you leave satisfied and well informed. We won't sell you anything you don't need.
Our team is led by Jonathan Wirth, an ASE master mechanic and diagnostician, along with David Hopkins, Matt Mckee and Jesus Uriostegui. If you have a problem no one else could find, bring it in and we'll work it out.
We're rated 4.3 from 49 Google reviews, and we're grateful to the neighbors who keep coming back.

## Services
- Smog test and repair: We're a test and repair smog station, so if your car doesn't pass, we can fix it here.
- Brake and lamp inspections: State certified brake and lamp inspections.
- Check engine light diagnostics: Find out what that light means before deciding on any repair.
- Oil change: Standard 5-quart oil change. ($ 46.00 and up)
- Transmission service: Routine transmission service. ($ 150.00 and Up)
- Engine repair: Diagnosis and repair of engine problems.
- Exhaust systems: Exhaust system work.
- Mileage plan service: Service on the mileage plan provided by your vehicle's manufacturer.
- Pre-purchase vehicle inspections: Have us look over a car before you buy it.
- Serpentine belts and batteries: We keep serpentine belts and Interstate Batteries in stock.

## FAQ
Q: Will I get an estimate before you do the work?
A: Yes. Every customer gets a written estimate for the repairs that need to be done, along with options for how to fix the car.

Q: Can you quote used parts?
A: Yes. Just ask, and we can include used parts pricing in your estimate.

Q: Do you offer commercial accounts?
A: We do. Ask us about commercial account pricing.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed on weekends.
